    • findRowsModel

      public static RowsModel findRowsModel(RowSet rs)
      Use this if you want a 1-1 correspondence between RowSet and RowsModel; for 1-1 only this method should be used. If an existing RowsModel for the RowSet is not found, a new RowsModel is created. If RowsModel.create(javax.sql.RowSet) is used multiple RowsModel can be created for the same RowSet; and see RowsModel.getActiveRowModels(javax.sql.RowSet)

      Can also use as a transition aid to RowsModel.

      Parameters:
      rs -
      Returns:

    • setupDefaultPrimaryKeys

      public static void setupDefaultPrimaryKeys(SsComponent comp)
      Setup a CachedRowSet's primary keys, use the component's row set to get the database table's keys. If not a CachedRowSet or the key is already set, do nothing. Note a JoinRowSet is skipped; only want to set keys for single table.
      Parameters:
      comp - component
